title: Matching Multi-Loop Complexities with a Single Loop: Optimal Optimization Stationarity and Best-Known Game Stationarity in Nonconvex--Concave Minimax Optimization
summary: We introduce a new single-loop algorithmic framework for smooth nonconvex--concave minimax optimization. The resulting projected damped extragradient method combines projected extragradient updates, dual momentum, and a moving proximal center. Under both the optimization-stationarity and game-stationarity criteria, our method achieves the best-known complexity among single-loop first-order methods.
